name: shadcnui-hono-jsx-workspace
description: Generator, tests and examples of shadcnui-hono-jsx (the CLI package is in cli/).

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/types/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/types/tsconfig.strict.json
scripts.test:visual: cd tests/visual && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run test
scripts.test:visual:styles: cd tests/visual && bun install --frozen-lockfile && cd ../.. && bun tests/visual/styles.ts
scripts.examples:test: bun run --filter example-hono test && bun run --filter example-honox smoke
scripts.verify: bun run dev:install && bun run site:install && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run site:typecheck && bun run test && bun run site:test && bun run generate --check && bun run site:generate --check
scripts.verify:full: bun run verify && bun run site:build && bun run site:smoke && bun run examples:build && bun run examples:typecheck && bun run examples:test && bun run test:install && bun run test:visual
scripts.site:dev: bun run site:install && bun site/scripts/previews.ts --dev && cd site && bunx vite
scripts.site:build: bun run site:install && bun site/scripts/release.ts && cd site && bun run build && bun scripts/previews.ts
scripts.site:deploy: bun run site:build && bun run site:smoke && cd site && bunx wrangler@4.141.0 deploy
